name: Inky
summary: A coral-reef sign-in page guarded by a purple octopus who covers her eyes for your password
about: A sunset coral-reef sign-in page with Inky, a purple octopus sitting on top of the form card. She follows your pointer and your typing, taps her tentacles and blows bubbles with each key, covers her eyes with two arms for the password and peeks when you show it. A wrong login makes her blush and puff ink; signing in turns her pink with waving tentacles and rising hearts.
how: The page opens on a drifting reef: light rays, swaying seaweed and bubbles, then Inky pops onto the card
Move the pointer and her eyes and head follow it; she blinks and bobs while she waits
Type your email and she looks along the text, tapping a tentacle and blowing a bubble for every key
Focus the password and two arms curl up over her eyes; press the eye button and one arm lifts so she can peek
Sign in with ayesha@demo.pk and reef1234 for the happy dance, or try other details to see her blush and puff ink
Sign out brings the form and Inky smoothly back to the start
